title: Hatsune Miku — That Glint In Your Eye〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's hard at work again today. I guess her shoot is just around the corner...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't realize you were here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, I came to watch Shizuku practice because she's so good at posing. I've been learning quite a lot from her.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see. Yes, Shizuku is an expert at that.
She sets a nice example.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you also here to see how she's doing, Haruka?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She looks really focused right now, so I'll just leave these here for her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <In that case, I'll let Shizuku know that you left these here for her when she decides to take a break.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They're all letting Shizuku work because they all believe in her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... I'm feeling a little thirsty.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think I'll take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, I didn't realize you were here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, I was just taking notes on how you pose♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <More importantly, take a look at what's on the table...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Gifts from the others.
Haruka stopped by a while ago to leave hers.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
These are just what I need, since I was just starting to get a little hungry.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What could be inside these? Crepes with meat and vegetables?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But they seem a little thick for crepes...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, there's something written on the wrapper.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “We made some tortilla wraps together for you♪ Bon appetit☆ Minori.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, they must've put a lot of effort into these!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, they look so colorful and delicious.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Dear Shizuku. Chicken breast is the best thing to eat when you're tired. Haruka.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “These are packed with meat and veggies, so they're a complete package nutritionally! Make sure to eat when you're feeling tired! Airi.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're giving you all the support they can...>
